name: comp-25
title: Search Keyboard Shortcut Input
description: A labelled search field with a small bordered shortcut badge fixed inside the right edge. Typing shows a native clear cross beside the badge; the shortcut itself is only a visual hint.
use: A page search that also advertises a command menu opening on the same shortcut.
avoid: The badge is decorative only; nothing listens for the shortcut, so it can mislead users.
a11y: The label is bound to the field, but the shortcut badge is decorative and never fires the key it shows. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A label sits above a rounded dark search field on a black stage. A grey Search... placeholder starts at the left, a tiny outlined ⌘K key badge hugs the right edge, and typing a query brings a small x cross before the badge.
behaves: Clicking the field draws a pale ring and typing replaces the placeholder with the query, which also produces a small clear cross next to the shortcut badge. The clip enters pricing table and the badge holds its place throughout.
customise: The label, placeholder and shortcut badge text are written in the file; field and badge styling are classes there as well.
weight: light: One field plus a static badge; nothing animates or listens in the background.
